title.a: Tax revenue gap kept tax-GDP ratio below potential 13.5%

item.description: Bangladesh’s tax-to-GDP ratio could have reached 13.5 percent if taxpayers had fully complied with existing laws. This could have been achieved without introducing new taxes or raising tax rates, according to a study by the Research and Policy Integration for Development (RAPID).
item.source: The Daily Star - Journalism without fear or favour
